clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 0: running the Program is not restricted. Output is covered only when its contents constitute a work based on the Program, not merely because the Program produced it.
clauses.condition_explanation: Running is permitted. Whether output is a work based on the Program depends on its contents and what the Program does.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 1: permission to copy verbatim copies of the Program's source code as received, in any medium. Notice requirements attach to each copy.
clauses.condition_explanation: Copying must be verbatim and as received; the specified notice conditions apply to each copy.

obligation_items.content: Publish an appropriate copyright notice and disclaimer of warranty conspicuously and appropriately on each copy.
obligation_items.object: each verbatim source-code copy of the Program
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee copies a covered copy

obligation_items.content: Keep intact all notices referring to the GPL and to the absence of warranty.
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee makes a covered copy

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 1: permission to distribute verbatim copies of the Program's source code as received, in any medium. Notice requirements attach to each copy and recipients receive a License copy along with the Program.
clauses.condition_explanation: Distribution must be of verbatim source code as received and satisfy the stated notice and license-delivery conditions.

obligation_items.content: Publish an appropriate copyright notice and disclaimer of warranty conspicuously and appropriately on each copy.
obligation_items.object: each verbatim source-code copy of the Program

obligation_items.content: Keep intact all notices referring to the GPL and to the absence of warranty.
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee distributes a covered copy

obligation_items.content: Give each other recipient a copy of the GPL along with the Program.
obligation_items.object: GPL copy accompanying the Program copy
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee distributes the Program to another recipient

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 1 permits charging for the physical act of transferring a copy and optionally offering warranty protection for a fee. This is not a payment obligation to the provider.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission concerns charging for physical transfer; offering warranty protection for a fee is optional.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2 permits modifying a copy or portion of the Program to form a work based on it. Conditions for copying or distributing resulting work are separately stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: The text permits modification; the listed conditions govern copying and distributing modifications or resulting work.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2 permits copying modifications or a work based on the Program subject to applicable section 1 and section 2 requirements.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applicable incorporated requirements include section 1 terms and section 2(a), (b), and, when triggered, (c), whose details are separately modeled.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2 permits distributing modifications or a work based on the Program subject to applicable section 1 and section 2 requirements.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applicable requirements include section 1 terms and section 2(a), (b), and, when triggered, (c), whose details are separately modeled.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2(a): distribution of modified files requires prominent notices stating that the files were changed and the date of any change.
clauses.condition_explanation: The duty applies to modified files when distributed.

obligation_items.content: Cause each modified file to carry a prominent notice stating that it was changed and the date of any change.
obligation_items.object: each modified file in the distributed work
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee distributes modified files

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2(b): a work distributed or published that in whole or part contains or is derived from the Program or any part must be licensed as a whole at no charge to all third parties under this License.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is distribution or publication of a qualifying work; the licensing condition applies to the work as a whole.

obligation_items.content: License the qualifying work as a whole at no charge to all third parties under the GPL.
obligation_items.actor: licensee distributing or publishing the work
obligation_items.object: the distributed or published work as a whole
obligation_items.trigger: when the work in whole or part contains or is derived from the Program or any part and is distributed or published

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2(c): applies to a modified program that normally reads commands interactively when run, when started in the most ordinary way for interactive use. Exception: no announcement is required if the Program itself is interactive but does not normally print one.
clauses.condition_explanation: The announcement includes an appropriate copyright notice; a no-warranty notice or statement that the licensee provides a warranty; notice that users may redistribute under these conditions; and how to view the License. The exception excuses the announcement in the specified case.

obligation_items.content: Cause the qualifying program to print or display the required announcement, including the appropriate copyright notice, warranty statement, redistribution information, and how to view the License.
obligation_items.trigger: when the modified program normally reads commands interactively and is started in the most ordinary way for interactive use, unless the stated exception applies

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2: requirements apply to the modified work as a whole. Identifiable, independent, separate sections not derived from the Program are outside the License when distributed separately; included in a whole work based on the Program, the whole must be distributed under the GPL and its permissions extend to every part.
clauses.condition_explanation: The separate-work exclusion requires an identifiable section not derived from the Program that is reasonably independent and separate and distributed separately. Inclusion in a covered whole invokes whole-work treatment.

obligation_items.content: Distribute the whole work on GPL terms when distributing independent sections as part of a whole work based on the Program.
obligation_items.object: the whole work based on the Program, including each part
obligation_items.trigger: when sections are distributed as part of a whole work based on the Program

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 2: mere aggregation on a storage or distribution medium does not bring another work not based on the Program under the GPL.
clauses.condition_explanation: The exclusion requires that the other work is not based on the Program and that the relationship is mere aggregation on a volume of a storage or distribution medium.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 3: object-code or executable distribution must satisfy sections 1 and 2 and one of section 3(a), (b), or (c). The source paths are alternatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: The source alternatives are OR, not cumulative. Complete source is defined in supplied context, including an exception for certain normally distributed operating-system components unless they accompany the executable.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 3(a): one alternative is accompanying the executable with complete corresponding machine-readable source, distributed under sections 1 and 2 on a customary software-interchange medium.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is one of three alternative source-compliance paths. Complete source is defined in supplied context, including its stated operating-system-component exception.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code or executable with complete corresponding machine-readable source, distributed under sections 1 and 2 on a medium customarily used for software interchange.
obligation_items.actor: licensee distributing the object code or executable
obligation_items.object: complete corresponding machine-readable source for the executable
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee selects section 3(a) as the source-compliance alternative

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 3(b): the written offer must be valid for at least three years, available to any third party, and limit the charge to no more than the cost of physically performing source distribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is one alternative to accompanying source or the narrowly available section 3(c) path.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the executable with a written offer, valid for at least three years, to provide any third party complete corresponding machine-readable source under sections 1 and 2 on a customary software-interchange medium, for no more than the physical source-distribution cost.
obligation_items.actor: licensee distributing the object code or executable
obligation_items.object: written offer for complete corresponding source
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee selects section 3(b) as the source-compliance alternative

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0 section 3(c): this alternative is allowed only for noncommercial distribution and only when the licensee received the Program in object-code or executable form with an offer in accord with section 3(b).
clauses.condition_explanation: All stated eligibility conditions are conjunctive. If eligible and this alternative is used, accompany the distribution with the received information about the source-distribution offer.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code or executable with the information received about the offer to distribute corresponding source code.
obligation_items.actor: licensee distributing the object code or executable
obligation_items.trigger: when the licensee uses section 3(c), the distribution is noncommercial, and the Program was received in object-code or executable form with a section 3(b) offer
